title: still present since round 4: vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally — nonexistent ids report success
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1245 (archive_vacancy): `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))`; :1259 (restore_vacancy): identical `Ok(vacancy_id)`; :1273 (close_vacancy): identical; :1356 (change_status): `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))`; :1493 (refcheck_action_with_contact): `Ok(call_id)`; :1547 (mark_notification_read): `Ok(notification_id)` — no find check anywhere, unlike update_vacancy/publish_vacancy which do `find_vacancy(next, vacancy_id) |> result.map(...)`. No test in client/test/demo/ feeds a nonexistent id to any mutation (grep for error-path pins: none).
detail: Error channel stays dead for six mutations; reverting to Error on unknown ids, or the UI's error handling for them, has zero coverage.
recommended_fix: list.find before mutating (mirror update_vacancy) and add one store-level test asserting Error on an unknown id.

title: still present since round 4: mark_opened doc claims idempotent Submitted->UnderReview but applies to any status
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1276-1291: `/// POST /open - idempotently moves a Submitted application to UnderReview /// and returns the post-transition status slug. pub fn mark_opened(...) -> #(DemoStore, Result(String, Nil)) { change_status( store, vacancy_id, application_id, "under_review", "status_auto_changed", ) }` — delegates to change_status with no guard on current status. (The sibling r4 note on the hardcoded "manual" trigger IS fixed — change_status now derives `trigger` from `event_type` — but no test asserts the "auto" detail.)
detail: A viewed/rejected applicant gets re-opened to under_review on re-view; doc/behaviour mismatch persists, unpinned either.
recommended_fix: Guard on current status == Submitted (no-op otherwise); pin the audit detail's trigger value for both event kinds.

title: still present since round 4: create_vacancy derives ids from an 8-char slug with no uniqueness check
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1125: `let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix`; :1683-1684: `/// Stable short id suffix from a property name (lowercase alphanumeric, /// up to 8 chars) so re-created demo vacancies don't collide.` then `fn id_suffix(value: String)` truncates to 8 chars with no store lookup. demo_create_vacancy_mutates_store_test creates ONE vacancy — no test creates two with the same name.
detail: Two "Test Cottage" creates produce the same id; the comment's collision claim is untrue and the collision path is untested.
recommended_fix: Check the derived id against the store, append a counter on collision; pin with a double-create test asserting distinct ids.

title: still present since round 4: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts
evidence: demo_api.gleam:116/128/140: `let _ = next` (three occurrences, one per reminder fn); demo_store.gleam:1408-1425: `pub fn remind_applicant(store: DemoStore, _vacancy_id: String,) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) { #(store, #(1, 0)) }` and `pub fn send_reminder(...) { #(store, #(2, 1)) }` — store returned unchanged, counts hardcoded. Grep for reminder/bulk_invite in client/test/demo/: zero matches — no coverage at all.
detail: Reminder buttons report canned successes that contradict the seeded awaiting list (2 rows, claims 2 sent 1 invalid); fully unpinned.
recommended_fix: Thread the store back (derive counts from static_awaiting, flip reminded/followed_up) and pin the awaiting-list mutation.

title: still present since round 4: store_of's None fallback re-seeds on every call without writing back to the model
evidence: demo_update.gleam:686-696: `pub fn store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore { case model.demo_store { Some(store) -> store None -> ... case demo_store.seed() { Ok(store) -> store Error(_) -> demo_store.empty_store() } } }` — every call with demo_store None builds a fresh store that never reaches Model.demo_store; no test drives the None path.
detail: A mutation dispatched against the fallback store is silently discarded; the defensive path is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Either make the invariant testable (assert Some in demo arms) or pin the fallback's empty-store resolution.

title: still present since round 4: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention — ids can collide
evidence: demo_update.gleam:645: `  let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1` (increment-then-use); client.gleam:7148 (add_toast): `  let id = model.next_toast_id` (use-then-increment, `next_toast_id: id + 1` at :7161). Sequence add_toast(id 0, next 1) then demo toast (uses 2, sets next 2) then add_toast (uses 2) — duplicate toast id 2. No test covers mixed toast sequences in demo.
detail: AppDismissToast filters by id — a collision dismisses both toasts; also skips add_toast's 5-toast cap.
recommended_fix: Reuse add_toast's convention (use next_toast_id, then +1); extract a shared toast helper both call.
